name: Ricardo Alves
bio:
Ricardo Alves's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karting, spending countless hours at local tracks. He transitioned to engineering, earning a degree and quickly finding his niche in race car development. His keen eye for detail and ability to motivate his team led to a rapid ascent, proving his capabilities in Formula Regional before stepping into a Team Principal role.

Ricardo is known for his data-driven approach, blending meticulous planning with a willingness to take calculated risks. He believes a strong team culture is the bedrock of success, fostering an environment where open communication and mutual respect are paramount. He is distinct for his unwavering commitment to nurturing young talent and empowering team members to reach their full potential.

His strategy is based on long-term planning, while also being able to dynamically adjust to changing circumstances during a race. He is always looking for new ways to get ahead and believes that adaptability is key for staying at the top of the sport.
